description: Tag-based classification of Microsoft Purview built-in sensitive information types. GUIDs are Microsoft built-in identifiers and are identical across all tenants. Tenant custom SITs will not appear here and are reported as untagged at runtime.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, EU, or GLOBAL where the type is not country specific. A SIT may carry more than one.

values.identity: Government or organisational identifiers for a person
values.financial: Accounts, cards, tax and banking identifiers
values.health: Clinical data, medical identifiers and terminology
values.credential: Keys, tokens, passwords and connection strings

pii.description: Whether the type identifies a person by itself.

values.direct: Identifies an individual on its own
values.indirect: Personal only in combination or with context
values.none: Not personal data. Organisational identifiers, codes and secrets

values.corroborating: Raises confidence in another type rather than standing alone
values.excluded: Not a privacy finding. Credentials and secrets

trait.description: Detection characteristics affecting noise and licensing.

values.named-entity: Dictionary-backed bundle. High recall, high noise
values.requires-e5: Requires a Microsoft 365 E5 licence (or equivalent compliance add-on). Applies to all credential scanning SITs and all named entity SITs.
values.checksum-validated: Validated by checksum such as Luhn. High precision
values.keyword-corroborated: Requires nearby keywords to reach high confidence
values.bundle: Wraps other SITs. Do not select alongside its members
values.pairs-with:<guid>: Precision improves when combined with the referenced SIT
values.exo-requires-priva: Named entity. At-rest classification in Exchange Online requires a privacy service plan in addition to E5. Microsoft documents the requirement as 'Privacy Service Plan' without defining the term; the only matching product is Microsoft Priva Privacy Risk Management, which is a PAID ADD-ON and is not included in E5. Without it Exchange returns zero for this SIT, which is indistinguishable from a genuine nil result. SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams are unaffected.

views.name: US Core PII
views.description: Direct personal identifiers for a US estate. Default reporting set and recommended DLP starting point.

views.name: US Extended PII
views.description: All US personal data including indirect identifiers, with the highest noise sources removed.

views.name: US All PII
views.description: Everything personal for a US estate including noisy named entities. Expect high false positive rates.

views.name: Health data
views.description: Clinical identifiers and terminology, any jurisdiction.

views.name: Credentials and secrets
views.description: Security finding rather than a privacy finding.

views.name: Everything
views.description: Every SIT known to the tenant.

sits.name: ABA Routing Number
sits.note: American Bankers Association routing number. US specific. Corroborates U.S. Bank Account Number rather than standing alone.

sits.name: All Full Names
sits.note: Matches almost any two capitalised tokens. Expect very high volume.

sits.name: All Medical Terms And Conditions
sits.note: Bundle of the medical term SITs. Selecting bundle and members together double counts.

sits.name: Amazon S3 Client Secret Access Key
Azure COSMOS DB Account Access Key
Azure IAAS Database Connection String and Azure SQL Connection String
Azure Logic App Shared Access Signature
Azure Machine Learning Web Service API Key
Azure Redis Cache Connection String Password
Azure Service Bus Shared Access Signature
Azure Shared Access Key / Web Hook Token
Azure Storage Account Shared Access Signature
Azure Storage Account Shared Access Signature for High Risk Resources
EU Social Security Number (SSN) or Equivalent ID
Impairments Listed In The U.S. Disability Evaluation Under Social Security
International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10-CM)
sits.note: Clinical Modification is the US adaptation of ICD-10. Health data but not a personal identifier alone.

sits.name: International Classification of Diseases (ICD-9-CM)
sits.note: Legacy US diagnosis code set. Still present in archived records.

sits.name: Lifestyles That Relate To Medical Conditions
New Zealand Ministry of Health Number
Singapore National Registration Identity Card (NRIC) Number
U.S. / U.K. Passport Number
sits.note: Single SIT covers both US and UK passports.

sits.name: U.S. Bank Account Number
sits.note: Weak pattern alone. Pair with ABA Routing Number to raise precision.

sits.name: U.S. Driver's License Number
sits.note: State formats vary widely. Noisy without keyword proximity.

sits.name: U.S. Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN)
sits.note: Taxpayer ID for non-SSN holders. Include wherever SSN is included.

sits.name: U.S. Physical Addresses
sits.note: Named entity. High volume and requires advanced classification licensing.

sits.name: U.S. Social Security Number (SSN)
sits.note: Highest-priority US identifier. Strong pattern with keyword corroboration.

licensing.note: Licensing materially changes what a scan can detect. A SIT that is not licensed returns zero rather than an error, so an unlicensed type is indistinguishable from a genuine nil result. Always confirm tenant licensing before interpreting any zero.

rules.requirement: Microsoft 365 E5, or an equivalent compliance add-on
rules.affects: All credential scanning SITs and all named entity SITs

rules.requirement: A privacy service plan, in addition to E5. Almost certainly Microsoft Priva Privacy Risk Management, which is a separately purchased add-on and is NOT included in any E5 SKU.
rules.affects: Named entity SITs evaluated against Exchange Online data at rest only. SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams are unaffected.
rules.confidence: Requirement is documented. The identification of 'Privacy Service Plan' as Microsoft Priva is inference, not a documented equivalence.

notApplicable.detail: A tenant setting required only for bundled SITs in ENDPOINT DLP policies. Not required for at-rest classification of Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive or Teams, and therefore not relevant to a Content Explorer census.

licensing.reportingRule: Where a SIT is not licensed for a workload, the result is zero rather than an error. Report those cells as 'not assessed' rather than 'none found', and state the licensing basis. Verify against the tenant service plans rather than assuming from the SKU name.
